title: The effect of soil-borne pathogens depends on the abundance of host tree species
subject: Biology
question: What is the approximate seedling survival rate for O. glaberrima when 50% of the soil is untreated and no fungicide is applied?

gold_answer.long_answer: For the 'No fungicide' series (solid black line with filled circles), locate the point corresponding to 50% on the x-axis (proportion of untreated soil). Reading across to the y-axis (seedling survival rate), the value is approximately 0.33.
